Chennai.title: Filter Coffee
Chennai.description: Chennai's soul in a cup — fragrant, frothy, and served in the iconic dabarah-tumbler set.

Chennai.title: Idli & Sambar
Chennai.description: The quintessential Tamil breakfast — pillowy soft idlis with aromatic sambar and three chutneys.

Chennai.title: Chettinad Chicken Curry
Chennai.description: Bold, complex spice blend unique to Chettinad cuisine — a fiery masterpiece.

Chennai.title: Kanchipuram Silk Saree
Chennai.description: Authentic GI-tagged Kanchipuram silk with gold zari borders — the queen of Indian sarees.

Madurai.title: Jigarthanda
Madurai.description: Madurai's legendary cold drink — almond resin, milk, ice cream, and sarsaparilla syrup.

Madurai.title: Bun Parotta
Madurai.description: Soft layered parotta served with mutton or veg salna — Madurai's beloved street staple.

Madurai.title: Mutton Biryani
Madurai.description: Madurai-style biryani is pot-roasted with whole spices giving a unique smoky flavour.

Madurai.title: Sungudi Saree
Madurai.description: GI-tagged tie-dye cotton saree created near Madurai — famous for its geometric dot patterns.

Ooty.title: Ooty Homemade Chocolates
Ooty.description: Rich, creamy homemade chocolates from Nilgiri dairies — best from Chocolate Grove and King Chocolates.

Ooty.title: Ooty Varkey Biscuits
Ooty.description: Crispy, buttery traditional biscuits — iconic to Ooty. Best bought fresh from Ooty Bakery.

Ooty.title: Nilgiri Tea
Ooty.description: Aromatic orthodox tea from Nilgiri estates — best purchased directly from estate shops.

Ooty.title: Eucalyptus Oil
Ooty.description: Pure cold-pressed eucalyptus oil — therapeutic and abundantly available in Ooty markets.

Thanjavur.title: Thanjavur Special Meals
Thanjavur.description: Traditional banana-leaf meals with rasam, sambar, kootu, and payasam — a Chola-era feast.

Thanjavur.title: Chettinad Cuisine
Thanjavur.description: Iconic spice-heavy cuisine unique to Chettinad — vellai paniyaram and kuzhi paniyaram are must-tries.

Thanjavur.title: Thalaiyatti Bommai Doll
Thanjavur.description: The iconic nodding-head Tanjore doll — handcrafted with clay, papier-mâché, and gold leaf.

Thanjavur.title: Tanjore Painting
Thanjavur.description: Classical South Indian gold-foil paintings of deities — best from Government Emporium, Thanjavur.

Kanchipuram.title: Kanchipuram Idli
Kanchipuram.description: Coarser, spicier idli flavored with cumin, pepper, and ginger — offered as prasad in Varadaraja Temple.

Kanchipuram.title: Temple Prasadam Sweets
Kanchipuram.description: Panchaamirtham and other temple sweets — a divine treat after temple visits.

Kanchipuram.title: Kanchipuram Silk Saree
Kanchipuram.description: GI-certified handwoven silk with heavy gold zari — buy from weavers' cooperatives for authenticity.

Kanchipuram.title: Kanchipuram Cotton Saree
Kanchipuram.description: Affordable, elegantly patterned cotton sarees — perfect for daily wear with a heritage touch.

Kodaikanal.title: Homemade Chocolates
Kodaikanal.description: Kodaikanal-style handmade chocolates — truffle, walnut, and fruit flavors from local shops.

Kodaikanal.title: Freshly Baked Goods
Kodaikanal.description: Carlton Hotel and local bakeries serve fresh bread, buns, and pastries loved by trekkers.

Kodaikanal.title: Eucalyptus Oil
Kodaikanal.description: Pure Kodaikanal eucalyptus oil — widely used for respiratory relief and body massage.

Kodaikanal.title: Handmade Jam & Preserves
Kodaikanal.description: Kodaikanal is famous for homemade strawberry, plum, and mixed-fruit jams from local cottages.

Thirunelveli.title: Tirunelveli Halwa
Thirunelveli.description: The legendary wheat-based halwa soaked in ghee — a 200-year-old Iruttu Kadai secret recipe.

Thirunelveli.title: Kola Urundai
Thirunelveli.description: Spiced minced meat balls — a beloved Tirunelveli street snack with unique local spice blend.

Thirunelveli.title: Palm Products
Thirunelveli.description: Palmyra-based crafts, baskets, fans, and accessories — handmade by local artisans.

Thirunelveli.title: Shenbagam Cloth
Thirunelveli.description: Traditional cotton fabric with distinct patterns — used for dhotis and sarees in southern TN.
